planted_discrepancies.how_planted: OM claims a double-digit income uplift within 12 months by comparing passing rents with asking rents for new lettings; passing rents already sit near the screen reference, so renewals allow 0% under Decree 43 and even uncapped re-lets at the reference add only a few percent.

expected.note: Supportable = every occupied unit re-let at the screen reference with no RERA cap (re-lets on turnover are uncapped); RERA renewal allowed = Decree 43 bands at renewal (top band 20%).

engine_inputs are built from TRUE facts (true 12-month costs, true unit areas and statuses), not from the documents.

Opex amounts are as paid, inclusive of non-recoverable VAT (opex_includes_vat: true). A stated management fee is included in opex_aed.property_management for completeness; the engine applies its own fee on EGI.
Occupancy counts occupied, notice-served, under-renewal and legal-case units as let.
Market reference rent per unit = area 1BR psf x unit-type factor x unit area (areas.yaml), as in the engine.
True 12-month opex includes Q4 items (lift AMC, fire systems, facade/BMU, second insurance instalment) that the Jan-Sep annualised statement misses.
